coverage.methodNotes: Counts only reviews whose URL was seen (WP API listings or WebSearch results). Metro Mag and Theatre Mirror/WBUR/Globe/BWW reviews are likely undercounted for shows with few hits. Excluded: tours, Gloucester Stage (outside metro), New Rep (closed), Reagle (no summer shows found), Moonbox (outside window), pre-April openings, community theatre, Umbrella Stage Co. productions. NSMT (Beverly) and Company Theatre (Norwell) are at the edge of the 25mi radius. Flagged items are small/fringe, dance, or borderline-date.

coverage.methodNotes: Opening dates are ESTIMATES (earliest-review minus lag or run info); no press-opening line was verified. companyType flags pro vs community/semi-pro (e.g. Ray of Light, Masquers, Hillbarn, Pear, Los Altos Stage, Palo Alto Players, Woodminster): count 'pro' only for a stricter census. Reviews counted only if a URL was seen in a feed/search listing; titles matched by keyword. Theatrius and Theatre Eddys are small-outlet reviews; Theatre Eddys posts are short blurbs. Mercury News and East Bay Times publish identical reviews (counted once, Mercury News). Bay City News critic assumed Jean Schiffman. Coverage gaps: BroadwayWorld Apr-Aug pages mostly not enumerated (only 8 URLs known), SF Chronicle and Talkin Broadway under-enumerated (Chronicle Hairspray/Dharma reviews seen by headline only, no URL, not counted), so review counts are floors. Excluded: Broadway tours (Hell's Kitchen, Oh Mary, Phantom, Beauty and the Beast, Jagged Little Pill), opera/ballet, university (Stanford TAPS, Foothill, CCAC), Oct openings (Peter Pan Goes Wrong SFP, Fall Show Shotgun, Liberation, Every Saturday Night, Betrayal, TheatreWorks Dracula), Mar openings (The Goat, Macbeth at Magic, Our Class, Dial M), and unidentified-venue shows (In the Heights, Wizard of Oz, The Uprising, Forgotten Island, Night Nurse, Hamlet SPARC, Going to St. Ives, A Few Good Men, Marsh remounts with old slugs). Not found: San Jose Rep, Aurora (no in-window season), Custom Made, Cal Shakes (no in-window show found), Ross Valley Players (Oct), Golden Gate Theatre (tours only).

coverage.methodNotes: Production list built from review-outlet indexes (BroadwayWorld local reviews, SDUT daily sitemaps, SD Story, Stage and Cinema, SDJW, Stage West, Kurahashi, Hoppe, FromAnother0) rather than season pages, so productions with no review in any of those outlets may be missing. Opening date = earliest dated counted review unless stated (press opening where known). Only review-style URLs counted; SDUT only counted when slug begins 'review-' (previews/features excluded). SDJW Eva Trieger pieces are previews and excluded; SDJW Spelling Bee (Lamplighters, La Mesa), Play That Goes Wrong 10/25 (Lamplighters), Lend Me a Soprano 4/7 (preview) not counted. SDTCC student reviewers, Spanish-language Times of San Diego write-ups not counted. Excluded as out of window or unclear: The Lehman Trilogy (Cygnet, ran to 4/26, opened before 4/1), Lizzie (PowPAC), Dead Man's Cell Phone (Trinity, October), Calendar Girls and Cabaret (company unknown), Topdog/Underdog (opened Oct 1), Carrie (Oct), tours at the Civic Theatre (Notebook, Sound of Music, MJ, Hell's Kitchen, Water for Elephants, Phantom, Oh Mary), opera/symphony. Critics named only where seen in bylines. Tiers via tier-of.js; Talk Theatre to Me, From Another Zero and Arts Meme are 'unknown' (not in registry). 'scale' field is my own flag separating major professional companies from small or community theatres so the parent can filter.
